qt: to the Commission João Oliveira (The Left) Subject:

On 13 November 2026, the Israeli authorities prevented Shawan Jabarin, General-Director of Al-Haq, a Palestinian human rights organisation, from leaving Palestine to head for Jordan, informing him that he was banned from travelling. This decision by the Israeli authorities is part of their growing crackdown and persecution of Palestinian organisations involved in documenting and exposing crimes against the Palestinian people and violations of international law (including human rights violations), which are the product of Israel’s policy of genocide, occupation and colonialisation. Let us not forget that Israel imposed an identical ban on Shawan Jabarin in 2006, and that, since 2021 in particular, Al-Haq has been in the cross hairs of repressive and persecutory action waged by Israel. Despite Israel’s repeated violations of international law, the EU has yet to take any meaningful action that would bring an end to Israel’s impunity. In light of the above: 1.
Will the Commission condemn the ban imposed on Shawan Jabarin? What démarches has it made, or does it intend to make, to the Israeli authorities to secure the immediate reversal of this measure?
What steps does it intend to put forward and take to put an end to the impunity of Israel, which is repeatedly and flagrantly violating international law?
